from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Initial Setup
        title = "The Speedometer Paradox"
        lines = [
            "Calculating average speed needs distance over time.",
            "But how fast is a cheetah exactly now?",
            "The speedometer shows speed at a single instant."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Use YELLOW for current line
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Speedometer setup
        speed_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        
        # Speedometer Mobjects (Right side area D4 to F6)
        arc = Arc(radius=1.2, start_angle=PI, angle=-PI, color=BLUE_B)
        ticks = VGroup(*[
            Line(arc.point_from_proportion(i/4), arc.point_from_proportion(i/4)*0.8, color=WHITE)
            for i in range(5)
        ])
        
        # Needle pivot is the arc center
        needle = Line(ORIGIN, LEFT * 1.0, color=RED, stroke_width=5)
        
        speed_num = DecimalNumber(0, num_decimal_places=0, font_size=36, color=WHITE)
        unit_label = Text("km/h", font_size=18, color=GREY_B)
        
        speedometer = VGroup(arc, ticks, needle, speed_num, unit_label)
        self.place_in_area(speedometer, "D4", "F6", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # Post-placement positions for sub-elements
        cp = arc.get_arc_center()
        speed_num.move_to(cp + DOWN * 0.4)
        unit_label.next_to(speed_num, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        
        # Efficient Updaters
        speed_num.add_updater(lambda d: d.set_value(speed_tracker.get_value()))
        
        def update_needle(m):
            val = speed_tracker.get_value()
            angle = PI - (val / 100) * PI
            length = 1.0 * 0.8 # Account for group scaling
            new_end = cp + np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle), 0]) * length
            m.set_points_as_corners([cp, new_end])
        
        needle.add_updater(update_needle)
        
        # Cheetah representation (Grid B1 to B6)
        cheetah_body = Square(side_length=0.4, fill_color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.8, color=YELLOW)
        cheetah_label = Text("Cheetah", font_size=18, color=WHITE).next_to(cheetah_body, UP, buff=0.1)
        cheetah = VGroup(cheetah_body, cheetah_label)
        self.place_at_grid(cheetah, "B1")
        
        # Ground Path
        path = Line(self.grid["B1"], self.grid["B6"], color=GREY_E, stroke_width=2)
        dist_label = Text("Distance", font_size=18, color=GREY_C).next_to(path, UP, buff=0.8)
        
        self.add(path, speedometer)
        self.play(FadeIn(cheetah, dist_label))
        
        # Movement 1: Demonstrate "Distance over Time"
        self.play(
            cheetah.animate.move_to(self.grid["B6"]),
            speed_tracker.animate.set_value(100),
            run_time=4,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Update lecture colors
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Reset for the "instantaneous" demonstration
        self.play(
            cheetah.animate.move_to(self.grid["B1"]),
            speed_tracker.animate.set_value(0),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        # Move and freeze at "4.5s" mark (visualized as 75% through the path)
        freeze_pos = self.grid["B1"] + 0.75 * (self.grid["B6"] - self.grid["B1"])
        
        self.play(
            cheetah.animate.move_to(freeze_pos),
            speed_tracker.animate.set_value(100),
            run_time=2.5,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        
        # Freeze action highlight
        self.play(Indicate(cheetah, color=YELLOW, scale_factor=1.2))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Update lecture colors
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Highlight speedometer value '100' with yellow glow (#FFFF00)
        glow_rect = SurroundingRectangle(speed_num, color="#FFFF00", buff=0.1, stroke_width=2)
        
        self.play(
            speed_num.animate.set_color("#FFFF00"),
            Create(glow_rect)
        )
        
        # Paradox text near cheetah (Red #FF0000)
        paradox_text = Text("Distance/Time = 0/0?", color="#FF0000", font_size=28)
        self.place_at_grid(paradox_text, "C4", scale_factor=0.9)
        
        self.play(Write(paradox_text))
        self.play(Flash(paradox_text, color="#FF0000"))
        
        self.wait(3)
